missed.label: Economy under-delivered
missed.desc: Growth 4 years to date came in below what the IMF forecast at the start.

ran.label: Stocks ran ahead of the economy
ran.desc: USD stock index rose faster than USD GDP over the same 4 years.

rosy_gdp.label: Growth forecasts too rosy
rosy_gdp.desc: Expected disappointment: forecasts minus their usual error. Next year uses the IMF, OECD and World Bank consensus; 3-5 years uses the IMF.

mcap.label: Market cap / GDP stretched
mcap.desc: Market cap as % of GDP against its own 10-year median (Mayuresh's measure). Broken data points are skipped.

rosy_inf.label: Inflation forecasts too low
rosy_inf.desc: Inflation usually comes in above forecast, which squeezes real returns and invites higher rates.

rosy_fis.label: Deficit forecasts too rosy
rosy_fis.desc: Government deficits usually come in worse than forecast.

rates_up.label: Rates expected to rise
rates_up.desc: OECD forecast of the short-term interest rate, 2027 vs 2026. Next-year view only; no history to test.
